run_evaluator_cli: run the evaluator CLI with --answers and --predictions flags to compute MRR scores
read_answers_jsonl: read a JSONL answers file mapping URLs to their correct answer indices
read_predictions_jsonl: read a JSONL predictions file mapping URLs to ranked answer lists
calculate_mrr_scores: calculate the Mean Reciprocal Rank score from answers and predictions dictionaries
evaluate_poj104_predictions: evaluate leaderboard predictions for the POJ-104 code search dataset
